**Keeping raw records on a device does not make every transmitted update private.** FedAvg trains local models and aggregates their updates at a server. Those updates can still encode information about local records, especially under a strong observer or repeated access. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1607.00133) [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.05629)

Differential privacy instead limits how much the distribution of released outputs can change when one protected contribution is added or removed. Epsilon controls the multiplicative bound and delta allows a specified slack. The neighboring-dataset definition must say whether the protected unit is one record or an entire user.

**Clipping bounds influence; noise obscures it.** DP-SGD limits contribution norms, adds calibrated noise, and accounts for cumulative privacy loss over steps. Clipping without noise is not the same guarantee, and noise without correct sensitivity accounting is insufficient.

DP does not promise that no familiar string can ever appear or that no population-level fact can be inferred. Its guarantee depends on the budget, access model, and correct implementation, with a utility tradeoff. Federated learning, secure aggregation, and differential privacy address different aspects of the system and should not be treated as interchangeable labels.

**Technical details and references.**

FedAvg sends local model updates for server aggregation rather than centralizing raw examples. Updates can still leak information; federated learning alone is not differential privacy. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1607.00133) [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.05629)

An $(\epsilon,\delta)$-DP mechanism bounds how output-event probabilities change between neighboring datasets: $P(M(D)\in S)\le e^\epsilon P(M(D')\in S)+\delta$. DP-SGD clips contributions, adds calibrated noise, and accounts for composition across training steps. Define whether neighbors differ by one record or an entire user.

DP limits an individual's influence under stated assumptions; it does not guarantee literally no memorized string or no inference from population facts. Privacy strength depends on the budget and implementation, with a utility tradeoff.
